account.upgrade.faq.title: Questions
account.upgrade.faq.billing.a: Plans bill monthly or yearly through Stripe. Top-ups are one-time payments of any amount from {min}, added to your balance right away.
account.upgrade.faq.refunds.q: What happens when a run fails?
account.upgrade.faq.refunds.a: Credits are held when a run starts and charged only when you get the result. Failed or canceled runs release the hold, and Activity shows the refund.
account.upgrade.faq.expiry.a: Purchased credits never expire. Your plan’s monthly credits refresh on your billing date and are used first; unused ones don’t carry over.
account.upgrade.faq.cancel.a: Yes. Cancel in Settings → Plan and billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and purchased credits stay in your workspace for when you come back.
account.upgrade.faq.change.a: Switch from this page or Settings at any time. Your balance stays as it is; the new plan’s perks and top-up bonus apply from the switch.
account.upgrade.faq.resolution.a: Each plan caps output resolution: Starter makes video up to {starter}, Plus up to {plus}, Pro up to {pro}. Locked options name the plan that unlocks them.
